messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Omeprazole can cause diarrhea, which may be a sign of a new infection. If you have diarrhea that is watery or bloody, call your doctor before using anti-diarrhea medicine.
Triplet: ["diarrhea", "may indicate", "new infection"]

The relation 'may indicate' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition or symptom may be a sign or indicator of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has symptom': The medical condition specified by the subject entity is characterized by the symptom or sign described by the object entity.
B. 'may be confused with': The subject condition or symptom may be mistaken for the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'occurs in': The medical condition specified by the subject entity is associated with or found in the group of individuals described by the object entity.
D. 'may cause': The subject action or condition can lead to or contribute to the development of the medical condition or effect specified by the object entity.
E. 'can reveal': The subject drug may uncover or make apparent the medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
